name: grp-mcp
description: Drive an Acumatica ERP instance from Claude: read, write, run processes and diagnose failures across the five APIs Acumatica actually has. Talks to your own instance directly - nothing is proxied, and credentials never leave your machine. Writes are off per profile until you enable them, and a clean 'ok' is never trusted: writes are read back and anything unconfirmed is reported as unverified. Runs on Windows, macOS and Linux from PyPI through uvx, so it needs uv installed - 'winget install astral-sh.uv' on Windows, 'brew install uv' on a Mac. Run tools\Edit-Connections.cmd once to create your connections file; it lands in %USERPROFILE%\grp-mcp (~/.grp-mcp on macOS and Linux), outside AppData where a Claude app update cannot delete it, and the server finds it with no environment variable set. LATEST (0.81.0-rc26): no change to what the tools do — this ships an addition to the knowledge base the server consults on your behalf before every write. It generalizes what a run of releases across the Company Tree and Approval Maps screens kept re-teaching, most usefully that a screen answers with only what was asked for, so an empty-looking result often means the question was incomplete rather than the record missing. That reasoning now reaches you in the guidance attached to a write, instead of living only in the repository. Full history in docs/CHANGELOG.md.
